# Chapter 18 ## Search and the Game of Othello

While much previous work on game playing has concentrated on chess and checkers, this chapter demonstrates a program to play the game of Othello.[1](#fn18-1) Othello is a variation on the nineteenth-century game Reversi.
The very name "Othello" derives from the fact that the game is so unpredictable, like the Moor of Venice.
In any case, the association between the game and the play carries over to the name of several programs: Cassio, Iago, and Bill.
